title: Headless chain: Gun Runners' Arsenal's set-up with the vendors lost before it runs (NVDLC05MQ00 nDLCSetup 2's safeguard: the add-on containers of dead or hostile vendors go to the Gun Runners' Vendortron); docs/handoff/mq-walkthrough-2026-10-27.md

actions.text: A game where the add-on is installed late: Mick, Cliff Briscoe and Torres already dead and the Van Graffs killed with Cass (given). The set-up quest's second step gives their add-on containers to the Vendortron's faction and moves them under its kiosk; the vendors alive (Chet, Lacey) keep theirs. The other outcome of the set-up (vendors alive) is the gun-runners-arsenal chain.
